title: Enable HTTP requests before Expense Agent setup
summary: The Expense Agent extension now enables HTTP client requests when the setup wizard opens, allowing service communication before full setup completion.
key_points: The setup wizard enables HTTP client requests for the Expense Agent extension when it opens
The setting change runs as a try function, so setup stays available if the platform setting cannot be changed
The allowance is applied before the canary allowlist probe, the wizard's first Expense Agent service request
The allowance persists, so later registration, processing, notification and deactivation requests use it
quote: Enable HTTP client requests for the Expense Agent extension when the setup wizard opens.
